title: OptiXDE: A fast optical-inspired solver for differential equations
summary: OptiXDE is a matrix-free spectral operator framework for differential equations on uniform grids and embedded domains. Inspired by angular-spectrum propagation in Fourier optics, it maps transform-diagonal spatial operators to analytical modal multipliers and composes them with physical-space operators for nonlinearities, geometry and boundary enforcement.
